spans.s: त्रुट् vi. 4P, 6P (pp. तृटित; pres. त्रुट्यति, त्रुटति) To tear, to break, to be split, तृटित इव मुक्तामणिसरः Ut.i., Bhartr.i.96.
त्रुटि f. 1. Cutting, breaking; 2. a small part, an atom; 3. a very minute space of time, equal to of 1/4th of a kshaṇa; 4. doubt, uncertainty; 5. loss, destruction; 6. a small cardamom (plant).
